title: Hazel and the Safehouse
author: Marguerite Lockridge
blurb: Kestrel Quintana, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
